comparisons.notes: Exact model TP19 (SKU IT-TP19), TempSwift ELITE, 0.5 sec thermocouple. Price is $29.99 (the $35.99 compare-at price was ignored). The store's product data shows available=true.

writeup: Woot has the TempPro TP19 instant-read meat thermometer (TempSwift ELITE, SKU IT-TP19, bright red) for $14.99. It is a 0.5-second thermocouple thermometer with a rinse-safe waterproof body, matched to ASIN B07R18W3W1 and GTIN 04897099880202. TempPro's own site lists the same TP19 in stock at $29.99, which is 50 percent higher and about $15 more. Nearby models TP19H and TP19HW were left out as different units. Quantity is capped, with at least three left and a limit of three per customer.
